This project is an Expo React Native app port of a golf handicap calculator (WHSCalcApp) using react-native-paper and @react-native-picker/picker. Use Expo-compatible imports and best practices. All UI should use Material Design components from react-native-paper. Avoid any non-Expo-compatible native modules.
